item.title: Bill deferred that would prohibit open carry of bladed weapons
item.description: Multiple machete-related violent crimes across Oahu left Hawaii lawmakers to revisit a proposal that would prohibit the open carry of any deadly or dangerous weapon.

item.title: Hawaiʻi tourism isn’t back, but it's resetting: A look at PATA
item.description: Tourism in Hawaiʻi is in the middle of a reset. Flight schedules adjust. Some visitor markets slow, while others show early signs of return. For local businesses that depend on tourism, instinct is no longer enough. Clear, reliable data has become essential to planning what comes next.
